aws_key_alias: A user-friendly name for this IAM credential (e.g., TeamKey).
aws_access_key: The AWS Access Key ID with S3 upload permissions.
aws_secret_key: The AWS Secret Access Key corresponding to the ID.
aws_bucket_name: The exact name of the target S3 bucket (e.g., cerebrus-assets-bucket).
aws_region: The AWS region where the bucket is hosted (e.g., us-east-1).
aws_key_mapping: The Credential Key Alias to use when connecting to this bucket.
aws_save_key: Encrypt and store this credential alias for use by S3 workflows.
aws_save_bucket_mapping: Save this bucket-to-credential mapping for uploader plugins.
